Admission: ProductionAdmission subclasses the owning frozen Admission and revalidates canonical/effectivity/source/membership/local-input/base/topology/receipt bindings before claim. Original Admission implementation remains untouched.
rationale: The original claim record has no top-level receipt SHA. The versioned adapter extends the same exclusive claim operation atomically with one receipt_sha256 field; no frozen ledger mutation and no second once-only protocol.

record_extension.receipt_sha256: SHA256 exact canonical restricted receipt bytes, or null for NONE

unchanged: original state and immutable terminal implementation
